subject: Feature migration safety net and price anchor
messages:
From: Clara Zhou <clara@medforge.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Packaging questions — impact of stepping tiers

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the initial notes on the package options. Before we hop on a call, a couple of concrete concerns from our side so the meeting is productive:

- If we need to step down from the Pro tier to Core for a quarter, what features are at risk (specifically: live-fallback, per-route caching, and model-variant routing)?
- Is there a safety net so customers keep entitlements for a short window after downgrading (we want to avoid a service regression in the middle of a launch rollback)
- Pricing clarity: MedForge needs a clear anchor when we discuss concessions with procurement — what discount band would you offer for a 12-month commit, and can you guarantee no feature removals during the first 60 days post-change?

I've attached our latest usage snapshot. If you could sketch 2–3 pragmatic options (minimal disruption / cost-first / commit-discount), that would be ideal.

Best,
Clara
Director of Product
MedForge
[Attachment: current_usage_report.pdf (PDF)]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Clara Zhou <clara@medforge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Feature migration safety net and price anchor

Clara — thanks for the clear list, that helps. Quick response with three concrete pathways; happy to walk through any of these on a short call.

1) Safety-first (minimal disruption)
- Entitlement hold: we preserve Pro-tier entitlements for 90 days after downgrade; circuit-breaker protection keeps per-route caching live for critical routes for up to 30 days.
- Proration: pro-rated credit for unused committed capacity.
- Pricing: no change to unit price during the 90-day hold.

2) Cost-first (quick downgrade)
- Immediate tier change; feature toggles removed within 48h except KV cache which we can hold for 7 days.
- One-off migration credit applied to the first invoice after the change.
- Pricing: standard metered pricing applies.

3) Commit-anchor (12-month term)
- 10% anchor discount on list pricing for the first 12 months (applies if you sign a 12-month commitment within 21 days).
- We will guarantee feature parity for at least 60 days post-change and provide a rollback path if performance drops >25%.

Attachments: I pushed a draft pricing model so you can play with the numbers. Ben — can you confirm if a 10% anchor is feasible for this ACV range or if we should propose a sliding band?

Next step: I can book a 30-minute alignment call tomorrow afternoon.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pricing-model.xlsx (Excel)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Clara Zhou <clara@medforge.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 14:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Feature migration safety net and price anchor

On Mon, Nov 2, 2026 at 11:03 AM Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Clara — thanks for the clear list, that helps. Quick response with three concrete pathways; happy to walk through any of these on a short call.

Lauren — +1 on the three pathways. For negotiation posture:
- Recommend we lead with Commit-anchor as the preferred option (keeps revenue predictable and addresses MedForge's procurement ask).
- Operational compromise: hold entitlements for 60 days (instead of 90) and add a 30‑day extended grace if usage shows sustained re-bound.
- Discount structure: 8–12% sliding scale depending on minimum commit. For DF-2026-1447 I suggest starting at 10% and building in a midpoint review at month 6 tied to usage.

I uploaded a short SOW draft that outlines entitlements, rollback triggers, and support SLAs — feel free to share with Clara as a starting point.

Ben Carter
Head of Sales, Americas
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOW-draft-v2.pdf (PDF)]

From: Clara Zhou <clara@medforge.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@medforge.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Feature migration safety net and price anchor

Thanks Lauren and Ben — that framing is helpful. A few clarifying points before the call:

- Rollback trigger: we prefer to tie rollback to a product-facing metric (end-user throughput on priority routes) rather than token volume; can you map the entitlements to a telemetry metric we can both observe?
- Entitlement hold duration: 60 days with a conditional 30-day extension sounds reasonable.
- Pricing: 10% anchor is acceptable as a starting offer, but procurement will need explicit language that the discount is conditional on the 12-month minimum and no retroactive clawbacks.

We have availability Wednesday 11/4 at 11:00 PST for a 30-minute sync — can you confirm?

Clara

On Mon, Nov 2, 2026 at 2:28 PM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I uploaded a short SOW draft that outlines entitlements, rollback triggers, and support SLAs — feel free to share with Clara as a starting point.

Clara / Tom — confirmed for Wed 11/4 11:00 PST. Agenda and immediate next steps below so everyone arrives aligned:

Agenda (30m):
- Quick walkthrough of MedForge usage (5m)
- Map critical features to entitlements and the telemetry signal (10m)
- Agree on rollback metric and timing; finalize entitlement hold length (10m)
- Next steps on pricing paperwork and DocuSign timing (5m)

Immediate next steps (owner):
- Redwood (Lauren / Karthik): produce a one-page entitlement-to-metric mapping and circulate by EOD today. Link to HubSpot record: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/DF-2026-1447.
- Redwood (Ben): prepare SOW redline that reflects a 10% anchor discount and 60+30 day entitlement hold.
- MedForge (Clara): confirm procurement constraints and any required legal language around non-clawback on the anchor discount.

I've attached the pricing model and the SOW Ben shared for your review. If anything changes before the meeting, flag here — we'll be on the call to follow up and capture agreed language for DocuSign.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Lauren Bishop
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
